title: THE RENDER WEEK · The log
venue: Arthur's site · a science-fiction week the papers declined · posted once, taken down
logline: Friday: the render fails. The panels fill with lines of text-shapes — a log, scrolling, a number in it the strip draws as two shapes — and the town behind the log going back to wireframe one thing at a time, the shack, the wall, the bench, until only Wood and the dog are solid and the bar under the last panel is empty. The week ends. The papers were right.

panels.composition: The seawall solid, and over it lines of text-shapes scrolling like a log, one two-shape number repeated.

panels.composition: Only the two of them, solid, on nothing, the bar empty, the log stopped.
